about: Field contract for FS10 audit ledgers and the golden format vectors in this directory.

entry.anonymous: bool; anonymous entries carry no dev/ino
entry.dev: u64 device of the fd at syscall enter, or null
entry.ino: u64 inode of the fd at syscall enter, or null
entry.path: readlink of /proc/PID/fd/N at enter, or null
entry.addr: u64 requested address (mmap/mremap old address, munmap start)
entry.result: i64 raw return: map address on success, -errno in -4095..=-1 on failure (F17: raw mmap failure is NOT exactly -1; that is libc's MAP_FAILED mapping one layer up)

verdict_rules: target-backed = syscall mmap, anonymous false, succeeded (result outside -4095..=-1), dev/ino equal the audited target
transient = a target-backed mmap whose result address is later covered by a munmap entry
anonymous successes prove the tracer observes syscalls; they are never attributed
